orgs.name: Project Liberty
orgs.mission: Restore agency in the digital age by giving people ownership and control of their personal data.
values: People, not platforms, should hold digital agency
Open infrastructure for a people-centered internet
Collaboration across technology, policy, and movement-building

orgs.name: Project Liberty Institute
orgs.mission: Advance research, policy engagement, and stewardship of open-source initiatives including the Decentralized Social Networking Protocol (DSNP), in collaboration with academic institutions.
values: Independent research and policy for human-centric infrastructure
Stewardship of open protocols rather than platform lock-in
Academic collaboration as a public good
